protocol.name: Kamino Lending
protocol.note: C27 build (2026-08-09) from the official deployed-program IDL (scripts/klend_idl.json, committed for reproducibility). All 51 discriminators are DERIVED as sha256("global:"+snake_case_name)[0..8] (the IDLs carry no byte arrays) and VERIFIED LIVE by on-chain census (scripts/census_drift_kamino.py, base58-correct decode): flashBorrowReserveLiquidity=87e734a70734d4c1, flashRepayReserveLiquidity=b97500cb60f5b4ba, refreshReserve=02da8aeb4fc91966, refreshReservesBatch=906e1a67a2ccfc93, refreshObligation=218493e497c04859, depositReserveLiquidityAndObligationCollateralV2=d8e0bf1bcc9766af, borrowObligationLiquidityV2=a1808ff5abc7c206, redeemReserveCollateral=ea75b57db98edc1d, depositReserveLiquidity=a9c91e7e06cd6644, initUserMetadata=75a9b045c5170fa2, initObligation=fb0ae74c1b0b9f60 all matched the derived value with zero unmatched â€” the convention is proven on the deployed binary. PDA seeds are grounded ONLY where the deployed program's account struct seed-constrains the derivation (C26: a wrong seed spec would flag legitimate txs): Drift initialize_user user=[user,authority,sub_account_id], initialize_user_stats user_stats=[user_stats,authority], deposit/withdraw/transfer_deposit spot_market_vault=[spot_market_vault,market_index], withdraw drift_signer=[drift_signer]; Kamino lending_market_authority=[lma,market] (every ix carrying it), init_reserve vaults=[reserve_liq_supply|fee_receiver|reserve_coll_mint|reserve_coll_supply, reserve] (ONLY init_reserve â€” runtime ixs constrain vaults by address-from-state, not PDA), init_user_metadata user_metadata=[user_meta,owner], init_obligation obligation=[tag,id,owner,market,seed1,seed2].
